QuestInfo.name: Urban Jungle - Continued
QuestInfo.0: There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal?
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Jack Masque. He's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for #o9400545#s, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 #o9400545#s in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...
QuestInfo.2: *Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky #o9400545#s, and in return, I received 5 #t2022194#s from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...?

0.0: Welcome back! Are you ready for another hunt?

yes.0: Ok, then! Same as last time. 100 #o9400545#s for a reward. See you when you return!

no.0: Unfortunate. Be on your way then!

1.0: Fantastic! I'll be able to face her again without worrying if one of those pesky #o9400545#s will spoil the moment. As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy!

yes.0: As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! Return to me tomorrow for another hunt!

mob.0: Tsk, tsk. So sad. I said #b100 #o9400545#s#k. Not 74, not 32, not 99. 100. Come back when you have something to show for your effort-besides a tired face.
